name: c2p
description: Compression-based prediction over typed causal hypergraphs and finite Markov kernels.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "server,frontend" -c "green,cyan" "npm run dev -w @c2p/server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @c2p/core && npm run build -w @c2p/server && npm run build -w frontend
